tools.name: google_docs_read_doc
tools.description:
This tool retrieves a JSON representation of the Google Doc given its document ID.

The JSON representation includes both the text as well as structural information about the document.

Corresponds to [`documents.get`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/get) in the REST API.

commentsIncluded.description: Optional. If true, comments will be included in the response. By default, comments are not included.

documentId.description: Required. The ID of the document to read. This is the same as file_id from Drive tools.

tools.name: google_docs_update_doc
tools.description:
Updates a document using batch update requests. It accepts a `documents.batchUpdate` request (as JSON).

Corresponds to [`documents.batchUpdate`](https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/batchUpdate) in the REST API.

The list of possible updates is:

- `replaceAllText`: Replaces all instances of the specified text.
  Schema:
    - `replaceText` (string, required): The text that will replace the matched text.
    - Criteria (exactly one required):
      - `containsText` (object): Criteria for matching text:
        - `text` (string, required): The text to se

WriteControl.description: Provides control over how write requests are executed.

requiredRevisionId.description: The revision ID of the document that the write request will be applied to. If this is not the latest revision of the document, the request will not be processed and will return a 400 bad request error. When a required revision ID is returned in a response, it indicates the revision ID of the document after the request was applied. Only one of this field or targetRevisionId should be set.

targetRevisionId.description: The target revision ID of the document that the write request will be applied to. If collaborator changes have occurred after the target revision ID was retrieved, the changes may produce a different result than if they were applied to the target revision ID. When a target revision ID is specified, the write request is applied based on the target revision ID and the revision ID of the document is incremented by 1. If you don't specify a target revision ID, the write request is applied to the latest revision ID and the revision ID of the document is incremented by 1. When a target revision ID is returned in a response, it indicates the revision ID of the document after the request was applied. Only one of this field or requiredRevisionId should be set.

writeMode.description: Optional. The write mode of the request.
x-google-enum-descriptions: The default write mode. A request without a write mode specified is treated as `EDIT`.
Changes are applied directly to the document.

documentId.description: Required. The ID of the document to update. This is the same as file_id from Drive tools.

requests.description: A list of updates to apply to the document. Each request should be a valid documents.batchUpdate Request object, using the schema documented in: https://developers.google.com/workspace/docs/api/reference/rest/v1/documents/request Requests will be applied in the order they are specified. If any request is not valid, no requests will be applied.

writeControl.description: Optional. Provides control over how write requests are executed.
